title: Candidate Fit Analyst
subtitle: Paste in a job description and it tells you, requirement by requirement, whether the candidate's published work covers it, with a link to the page that shows it.
lede: Paste in a job description and it tells you, requirement by requirement, whether the candidate's published work covers it, with a link to the page that shows it. It also lists the gaps plainly.
who: A recruiter or a hiring manager
author: Corey James
